title: Multimedia Asset Personalization via Multimodal Embeddings at Netflix
abstract: arXiv:2608.18322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized promotional assets, namely artwork images and video preview clips, are critical to content discovery on Netflix. Traditional models for asset selection rely on ID-based interaction history, leaving them blind to asset content and unable to serve newly launched titles and assets. We describe how multimodal embeddings reshaped production systems at Netflix and report transferable lessons for practitioners adopting foundation-model embeddings into recommender systems. First, pretrained image embeddings unlock cross-title, cross-canvas knowledge transfer. Augmenting a two-tower model with CLIP image embeddings lets a single model serve all five Netflix artwork canvas types, replacing five separately trained per-canvas models and substantially improving cold-start performance. translated_title: 奈飞多媒体资产通过多模态嵌入实现个性化
translated_abstract: 个性化促销资产，即艺术作品图片和视频预览片段，对于奈飞上的内容发现至关重要。传统的资产选择模型依赖于基于ID的交互历史，这使它们对资产内容视而不见，无法服务于新推出的标题和资产。我们描述了多模态嵌入如何重塑了奈飞的生产系统，并报告了为从业者将基础模型嵌入应用于推荐系统的可转移经验。首先，预训练的图像嵌入解锁了跨标题、跨画布的知识转移。通过向双塔模型添加CLIP图像嵌入，一个单一模型即可服务于所有五种奈飞艺术作品画布类型，取代了五个分别训练的每画布模型，并大幅提升了冷启动性能。一个轻量级扩展复用了CLIP的联合文本-图像空间，使艺术作品个性化在搜索中具备查询感知能力。其次，多模态性在性能上决定性胜出。
tldr: 奈飞利用多模态嵌入（如CLIP）统一了艺术作品个性化模型，实现跨画布知识转移和冷启动性能提升，并扩展至查询感知搜索。
en_tdlr: Netflix leverages multimodal embeddings (e.g., CLIP) to unify artwork personalization models, enabling cross-canvas knowledge transfer and improved cold-start performance, with extension to query-aware search.
